values.note: 4 sites in the front loop and 9 in the back loop.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/slate-creek-campground ('has 4 sites ... in the front loop. There are 9 sites ... in the back loop', 'Campground can accommodate RV's or trailers to 25 feet.'; last updated October 22, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: A vault toilet in each loop. Pack it in, pack it out; no garbage service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/slate-creek-campground ('a vault toilet in the front loop', 'an additional vault toilet located in the back loop', 'Potable water is not available at this site.', 'Pack it in, Pack it out, no garbage service provided.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Front loop open year round, snow dependent. Back loop open June through September 30th.'

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/slate-creek-campground ('Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $5/night per additional vehicle. Cash or check.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/slate-creek-campground ('Single Site: $10/night. Additional Vehicle: $5/night.', 'Please be prepared to pay with CASH or CHECK.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 50% off single campsites only, for the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/slate-creek-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to Single Campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF (West Fork RD), on Slate Creek near Painted Rocks Lake, ~23.6 mi up West Fork Road from Darby (east side of the road). --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Oct 22, 2026): confirmed 13 sites (4 front, 9 back), 25-ft RVs/trailers, vault toilets, no water, $10 (+$5 extra vehicle, cash/check), Senior/Access 50% (now on the entry); added 16-day limit and season (front loop year-round, back loop June - Sept 30). Not stated: reservations/FCFS (derived left; the Reservations section is empty). Alerts: only a prescribed burn elsewhere. Note trimmed of restated values.
